name: Gasthaus Wiesejaggl
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Gasthaus Wiesejaggl in Tirol**

Nestled in the heart of the **Tiroler Alps**, **Gasthaus Wiesejaggl** invites you to experience authentic **Tiroler** hospitality in a cozy mountain setting. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this charming guesthouse offers warm, rustic charm with breathtaking views of the surrounding peaks.

Indulge in traditional **Tiroler** cuisine, where every dish tells a story of the region. Savor hearty **Kaiserschmarrn** for breakfast, melt-in-your-mouth **Speckknödel**, or a perfectly grilled **Tiroler Gröstl**—each bite is a celebration of local flavors. Pair your meal with a glass of crisp **Tiroler** wine or a frothy **Schnaps** for the true alpine experience.

After a day of hiking, skiing, or exploring the **Zillertal** or **Ötztal** valleys, unwind in our cozy common room by the crackling fireplace. Whether you're seeking adventure or relaxation, **Gasthaus Wiesejaggl** promises an unforgettable stay in the heart of **Tirol**.

<iframe src="https://www.google.com/maps/embed?pb=..." width="600" height="450" style="border:0;" allowfullscreen="" loading="lazy"></iframe>

**Come, stay, and let the spirit of Tirol welcome you home.**
